headline: Best flying mounts in Palworld 1.0
title: Best Flying Mounts in Palworld | Jetragon, Xenolord and Easy Early Picks | Palworld Guide
video_script: Which flying mount should you use in Palworld one point zero? At the top, most rankings agree on two Pals, Jetragon and Xenolord. Jetragon is the classic speed king, and Xenolord is great for long flights. Before the endgame, Helzephyr is one of the best easy upgrades for getting around, and Beakon is a strong mid game flyer. Remember, every mount needs its saddle before you can ride it. What do you fly on? Comment below!
